tier2_explanatory.long_meaning: From the Greek andreios, 'manly, brave', from anēr, 'man'. Its root is Greek anēr (ἀνήρ). Andrew the Apostle, brother of Peter. Andrew is a Greek name meaning “Manly; brave”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
